summary: Elutia Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of the sale of its SimpliDerm Business (hADM products for breast reconstruction) to Cellution Biologics Inc. The sale closed on August 17, 2026, with $7.7 million paid at closing, subject to post-closing inventory adjustment and up to $3 million in contingent milestone payments over 18 months. Elutia entered a five-year non-competition agreement and a six-month transition services agreement. The company amended its loan agreement to release liens on the assets. Watch for inventory valuation adjustments and milestone achievements.
